title: Anatomical imaging acquisition efficiency (author estimates)

source_paper.verified_title: Compiling molecular ultrastructure into neural dynamics

rules: Use published Approx. Voxels/$ column, not throughput/cost recomputation.
All points are estimates, not measured normalized costs. Do not add statistical error bars.
Different resolution, labeling, voxel sampling and cost scopes; not equal biological information or native tissue volume.
Keep PEEM prospective/mixed and unresolved 2024 ExA-SPIM citation visible.
No universal fitted doubling line: source fit method/bands not documented and figure/table mismatch exists.
Table has 11 rows; Figure 2 has 11 visible points, including a TEMCA point absent from Table A1 and excluding mesoSPIM.
suggested_caption: Approximate acquisition economics, from crowdsourced order-of-magnitude estimates in Kording et al., arXiv:2603.25713v1, Table A1. Voxels are not resolution- or information-equivalent across optical and electron microscopy; costs are not verified all-in connectome costs. PEEM mixes demonstration with prospective throughput; the 2024 ExA-SPIM reference is mismatched.
